# Support

- If Fuse is silent, slow or failing, read [Troubleshooting](https://fuse.codes/docs/troubleshooting) first. That page explains each message and where the logs are.
- If you have a question about using Fuse, ask in [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/Litenova-Solutions/Fuse/discussions).
- If you found a bug or want a feature, open an [issue](https://github.com/Litenova-Solutions/Fuse/issues/new/choose). Include the output of `fuse --version`.
- If you found a vulnerability, do not open an issue. Follow [Security](https://github.com/Litenova-Solutions/Fuse/blob/main/SECURITY.md) to report it privately.

You can find every page in the [documentation](https://fuse.codes/docs/), listed by what you want to do.
